verdict.line: You lose if you let him hit level 2 all-ins or stack 5 bleeds before you can back off, and you win every trade where you land Blinding Dart before his Decimate windup finishes.

brief.thesis: Darius has the kill pressure and Teemo has the range, so this is EVEN overall (54.5% over 2079 games) but shaped entirely around whether you trade from 680 range or let him close to his axe. Every stat point of his Hemorrhage passive is a timer against you; every poke you land before he reaches melee is free damage he can't return.

theirWindow.when: He lands E (Apprehend) hook on you
theirWindow.what: Once he pulls you in with E (Apprehend, range 535, cooldown 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s), you're in his Q (Decimate) and W (Crippling Strike) range with no escape — Flash out immediately rather than trying to fight back, since his passive stacks will snowball into enrage damage.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and poke with E (Toxic Shot) autos plus Q (Blinding Dart, cooldown 8s, range 680) — he has no gap closer besides the hook, so outside 535 range you're completely safe to harass.

playing.title: Hold Q for his engage
playing.detail: Save Blinding Dart (cooldown 8s) to blind him the instant he commits E (Apprehend) or walks into Q (Decimate) range — the blind shuts off his auto-attacks and Crippling Strike slow entirely.

playing.title: Never fight past 3 stacks
playing.detail: Hemorrhage stacks up to 5 and enrages him with massive bonus AD at max stacks — disengage the moment you see 3+ bleed icons on your health bar, since that enrage threshold is where trades flip hard against you.

playing.title: Poke from max E range
playing.detail: Toxic Shot has 680 range and zero cooldown, so you can auto him from well outside his 535-range Apprehend and still apply poison damage over time for free.

playing.title: Trap his jungle entry, not lane
playing.detail: Drop Noxious Trap (cooldown 1s, range 230) along river/tribrush entrances rather than in lane — it reveals ganks and slows his jungler's engage without wasting mushrooms on a target that's too tanky to care about the DoT alone.

playing.title: Punish cooldown windows on E
playing.detail: Apprehend's cooldown is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — track when he's used it and walk up aggressively to poke during that window since he has zero gap-close otherwise.

playing.title: Use W to disengage, not chase
playing.detail: Move Quick's movement speed is removed the instant a champion or turret hits you, so use it proactively to walk out of range before he swings, not to run him down into his own W slow.

playing.title: Freeze the wave at level 2
playing.detail: His level 2 all-in (Q into E) is the strongest burst window he has before your poke scales — hold the wave near your tower so he has to overextend to reach you.

brief.patchCaveat: All win rates, pick rates, item paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own tactical read, not measured data.
